text: Sounds like a confusing situation - but what the embassy person says is right, from what I understand. The embassy can't give a B1 visa or any specific visa related to the process - they only give a B2 visa that lets your partner enter Israel to start the process. So your partner would need to book an appointment at the embassy so they can put a B2 visa in his passport. Maybe that is what they are wanting him to go do?
